note: Editorial product-identity rules. A generic identity is a descriptive type of thing; branded is a specific named commercial product/model even when no manufacturer is recorded; bespoke is configured/made to order; unique is a singular or exceptional object. Manufacturer links and explicit item curation remain stronger evidence than naming alone.
